title: 2 Kings Bible Quiz - Chapter 20
description: Ten questions on 2 Kings 20: Hezekiah's illness and healing, the sign of the shadow and the envoys from Babylon.

questions.text: What did Isaiah first tell the sick Hezekiah that Yahweh said?
questions.explanation: Isaiah said, "Yahweh says, 'Set your house in order; for you will die, and not live.'"

answers.text: "Go up to Yahweh's house and offer a sacrifice."
"Set your house in order; for you will die, and not live."

questions.text: What did Hezekiah do when he prayed to Yahweh after hearing this?
questions.explanation: He turned his face to the wall and prayed to Yahweh.

answers.text: He went up to the roof
He turned his face to the wall
He lay on the ground in ashes

questions.text: On which day did Yahweh say Hezekiah would go up to Yahweh's house?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "I will heal you. On the third day, you will go up to Yahweh's house."

questions.text: How many years did Yahweh say he would add to Hezekiah's days?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "I will add to your days fifteen years."

questions.text: What did Isaiah tell them to lay on Hezekiah's boil?
questions.explanation: Isaiah said, "Take a cake of figs." They laid it on the boil, and he recovered.
Hezekiah said it was a light thing for the shadow to go forward ten steps, and asked that the shadow return backward ten steps.

answers.text: The shadow returning backward ten steps
The shadow going forward ten steps
The sun standing still for a day
Fire coming down on the altar

questions.text: Which king of Babylon sent letters and a present to Hezekiah?
questions.explanation: Berodach Baladan the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present, for he had heard that Hezekiah had been sick.

questions.text: What did Hezekiah show the envoys from Babylon?
questions.explanation: Hezekiah answered, "They have seen all that is in my house. There is nothing among my treasures that I have not shown them."

answers.text: Only the house of his armor and weapons
Everything in his house and treasures
Only Yahweh's house and its courts
Nothing, for he sent them away

questions.text: What did Isaiah say would happen to some of Hezekiah's sons?
questions.explanation: Isaiah said some of his sons would be taken away and would be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.

answers.text: They would be killed by the sword of Assyria
They would become prophets in Jerusalem
They would rule over the land of Assyria
They would be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon

questions.text: Who reigned in Hezekiah's place after he died?
questions.explanation: Hezekiah slept with his fathers, and Manasseh his son reigned in his place.
